question: A 68-year-old male with past history of hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and a 30 pack/year smoking history presents to his primary care physician for his annual physical. Because of his age and past smoking history, he is sent for screening abdominal ultrasound. He is found to have a 4 cm infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm. Surgical repair of his aneurysm is indicated if which of the following are present?

options.opd: Growth of < 0.5 cm in one year
